mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.5% (current level: 0.07%) indicates an ultra-accommodative monetary policy that reduces the risk-free rate and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% (current level: 8.5%) indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An ultra-low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) combined with low core inflation (CPIAUCSL 12-month change < 2.0%) indicates a stable monetary environment that supports risk-taking and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL_12m_change < 2.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% and unemployment rate below 4.0%), the economy is overheating, leading to expectations of monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1_qoq_growth > 2.0 and UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive growth rate in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate is positive, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 (current level: 94.8263) indicates a weakening economy that suppresses corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 90, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 650 and retail sales (RSAFS) are below 400000, it indicates a weak consumer demand environment that suppresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST < 650 and RSAFS < 400000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 650, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
